page.overview:
Who is Mr. Bean?

Mr. Bean is a fictional character. He lives in London with his Teddy and drives a green Mini 1000.

After the Simpson family met British Prime Minister Tony Blair, Homer mistook him for Mr. Bean, getting excited as he couldn't believe they had met Mr. Bean.

and played the titular role of Johnny English in Johnny English and its sequels Johnny English Reborn and Johnny English Strikes Again. Atkinson is also famous for his portrayal of Edmund Blackadder in the BBC TV sitcom "Blackadder", the titular role in the 2016 detective drama series Maigret, and for playing small roles in films such as: Never Say Never Again, Four Weddings and a Funeral, Rat Race, Scooby Doo, Love Actually and Keeping Mum.
